metadata.description: Carrel — a library desk for your files, and your agents. Local file toolkit plugins: convert, OCR, edit, inspect, index/search, pack for LLM context, organize, redact/sign/forms, watch, agent workflows, and a Read guard that turns PDFs and Office files into text for Claude.

plugins.name: carrel-convert
plugins.description: Convert, OCR, thumbnail, edit, extract images from, and narrate local files with the carrel CLI: /convert, /ocr, /thumb, /edit, /extract-images, /audiobook, plus a doc-converter batch agent.

plugins.name: carrel-inspect
plugins.description: Inspect, diff, search, and pack local files for LLM context with the carrel CLI: /inspect, /diff, /search, /pack, plus a context-packing skill.

plugins.name: carrel-organize
plugins.description: Organize, dedupe, tag, annotate, record typed fields, rename from document fields, and batch-process local files with the carrel CLI: /organize, /dedupe, /tag, /note-file, /meta, /rename, /batch.

plugins.name: carrel-documents
plugins.description: Document craft with the carrel CLI: /redact, /sign, /form, /proof, /color, a document-clerk agent (redact → verify → sign manifest) and a redaction-and-provenance skill.

plugins.name: carrel-finance
plugins.description: Accounting desk work with the carrel CLI: /refs finds invoice, PO, IBAN, routing, VAT and tracking numbers across files, tags files with them, and shows which documents share a reference; /fields extracts vendor, dates, totals and currency from invoices, receipts and statements. Plus a bookkeeper agent and an accounting-inbox skill.

plugins.name: carrel-mail
plugins.description: Email archives with the carrel CLI: /mail saves attachments, splits an mbox into messages, groups eml/mbox files into threads and converts Outlook .pst exports; eml/mbox are first-class desk files for index, search, pack, refs and the Read guard; plus a mail-archive skill.

plugins.name: carrel-watch
plugins.description: Watch folders and file inboxes with the carrel CLI: /watch-folder runs actions on file events (recursive, settle-wait, polling, done/error dirs, service definitions); /intake reads each arriving document, names it, files it by date or fiscal period, indexes it and tags it with its reference numbers. Plus a watch-automation recipe skill.

plugins.name: carrel-agent
plugins.description: Agentic file librarian for carrel desks: /index, /doctor, /catalog, /completion, a file-librarian agent, an agent-workflows skill, the carrel MCP server (14 tools + carrel:// resources), and a PostToolUse hook that re-indexes files Claude writes.

plugins.name: carrel-guard
plugins.description: Hooks that let Claude read what it otherwise cannot: a PreToolUse guard converts PDFs, Office/ebook files and images to text via carrel before Read sees them, and a SessionStart hook reports what carrel can do in this environment.
